#  14018 - Introduction to Scientific Work Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **14018**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Introduction to Scientific Work**  |  
|  Einführung in das wissenschaftliche Arbeiten   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 2 - Environment and Natural Sciences   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Dr. rer. nat. Braune, Steffen 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | This module teaches the basics of scientific work that are relevant for the courses of study at the Institute of Biotechnology. Students who have taken part in the module are able to:
  * apply learned strategies for literature research independently and effectively,
  * apply the knowledge acquired for the effective acquisition and processing of information to a literature search carried out,
  * apply copyright principles and correct citations to their own work,
  * apply the skills learned in work organisation and time management to their own work,
  * independently develop a project schedule from a given task,
  * apply the knowledge gained about the content and structural requirements in the preparation of their own graduation projects,
  * independently create and critically evaluate parts of a scientific work, develop a presentation on a given topic with the help of the acquired knowledge on content and structural requirements,
  * use the presentation techniques learned during the presentation

 |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Literature research and processing (search strategies, database search, citation styles, analysis of literature sources, literature management, conducting literature research as an exercise)
  * Work organisation and time management
  * Preparation of a scientific paper (structure, content requirements, form and typography, drafting of parts of a scientific paper)
  * Presentation techniques (structure and content of the presentation, foil design, presentation style, performance of a presentation)

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Basic knowledge in scientific work including Experience from the Introduction to Laboratory Work course  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Seminar scriptFurther references will be given at the beginning of the seminar.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Partial performance: Exercise on "Literature research and processing" (33 %)
  * 2nd part: Exercise on the topic "Preparation of a scientific paper" (33 %)
  * 3rd part: Lecture with discussion on the topic "Presentation techniques", duration 8 minutes (34 %)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Bachelor (research-oriented) / Life Science and International Health / PO 2025 

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | Seminar Introduction to scientific Work  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
